correctness.rationale: Binary threshold-one parallel firing shifts the four support positions right by one per round until sink absorption, so all generating simplices are precisely clipped translates. Set L=g+2. At each of t trailing-zero removal stages, the terminal vertex link is a triangle joined to an edge along a cone apex, giving exactly five legal free-face pairs and deletion K_m -> K_(m-1). At base m=L+2 one tetrahedron, one triangle and consecutive edges admit four elementary pairs deleting vertex 0, then three free-face pairs eliminating the two triangles/pendant leaf, leaving C_L. Total 5t+7. Independently reconstructed all simplices and checked exact freeness at each pair for 72 L,t instances; proof itself is uniform and covers arbitrarily large g,t.

Its complete published proof is by successive homotopy pushouts along contractible attaching subcomplexes and does not provide an elementary simplicial collapse onto a specific canonical L-cycle, or an all-parameter 7+5t free-face certificate. The audited final claim is the latter stronger simple-homotopy/collapse statement; it is not a logical corollary of homotopy equivalence alone. Do not claim novelty for the terminal S1 or persistence.
